ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels against 25% low-intensity black/grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark continuous pigmentation along the trailing and distal edges; large contiguous dark hub at the peduncle insertion point; irregular grey/black mottled clusters across medial surfaces; distinct high-contrast circular focal spots on both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth occupying roughly 6% of the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 2 to 12 pixels, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve consisting of a concave sweep originating at the median notch and transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular high-contrast ring-like pixel clusters; two adjacent rings on the right medial lobe, one ring on the right distal lobe, and two visible rings on the left medial lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily concentrated on the central and right lobe surfaces, breaking the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization forming dense clusters of high-contrast spherical pixel groups on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; multiple distinct rake marks and circular scarring across the ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized 'beaded' edge texture on both distal tips resulting from dense barnacle colonization, creating a unique visual boundary distinct from the serrated trailing edge.
